title: Jack Gordon's three unnamed aircraft

tellings.quote: I've I've been responsible for 15 real flying uh aircraft in my time.

plain: Nick Cook, a guest on a podcast about antigravity aircraft, tells of a man named Jack Gordon connected to the Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design shop in Palmdale, California, in the mid-1990s. According to Cook, Gordon said he had been responsible for 15 real flying aircraft in his time, and the story holds that three of them have never been named. If true, it would mean secret aircraft exist that the public has never heard of.
